items.notes: Training Session 1 takes about ten minutes. It ends with a practice service run with no wrong slide and no desktop showing.
Press Space when the video ends.
Point at each part of the real screen as the slides describe it: the wall, the LIVE and NEXT cards, the right side, and Show, Idle and Blank.

video.name: Going live and moving through slides.mp4

items.notes: Press Space when the video ends. Then the practice starts.

header.title: Practice. Run these as if it were Sunday

items.notes: From here on the trainee drives. The trainer watches the projector, not the laptop.
Practice: press Space for each verse. At the last verse, press 1 to jump back to verse 1, then Space to the end. One more Space moves to the reading.
Practice: a Bible reading. Space through the verses. Watch the gold NEXT card to see what comes after the last one.
Press Space when the video ends. Then try each one on the sermon deck: full stop to blank, Idle, Clear text, and Show to come back.

Practice: five slides with builds. Watch the On air box on the right: what is on screen, the next click, and the clicks left. The preacher's notes for each slide are in the slide's own notes. Try Blank (full stop) once in the middle, then bring it back. Try Focus (F) too, and Esc to come back.
Hand over the printed key sheet. Then close the service with Close service, top right.
